name: selection-bar
title: Selection bar
description: A toolbar that rises while rows are ticked: the count, one-click actions with Undo, More and Clear (Esc). Big or partly hidden changes ask first.

props.name: count
props.description: How many rows are picked. The bar shows while it is above 0 (and while a notice is up).

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called by Clear, Esc and the More menu's Clear item.

props.name: actions
props.description: The quick actions, shown as buttons; one with `options` is a menu.

props.name: more
props.description: Actions under More (…), as menu items. Clear selection is always added at the end.

props.name: maxInstant
props.description: One click changes at most this many rows; above it the change goes to onNeedsConfirm. Default 10.

props.name: hiddenCount
props.description: Picked rows that are not on screen. When above 0, a change goes to onNeedsConfirm. Default 0.

props.name: onNeedsConfirm
props.description: Called instead of a change that is too big or reaches rows off screen. Without it, such a change runs.

props.name: onSelectAll
props.description: Adds "Select all {count}" to More while fewer than that are picked.

props.name: selectAllCount
props.description: How many rows "Select all" would pick.

props.name: escapeClears
props.description: Esc clears the selection, unless focus is in a text field or a dialog is open. Default true.

props.name: undoSeconds
props.description: Seconds the notice with Undo stays, paused while hovered or focused. Default 8.

props.name: placement
props.description: "sticky" sits at the bottom of the scrolling box, in the flow; "fixed" sits at the bottom of the screen and leaves a spacer of its height. Default "sticky".

props.name: labels
props.description: Visible and spoken text, with English defaults.

a11y.text: The bar is a toolbar with one Tab stop: ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between its buttons, Home and End jump to the ends. A menu button opens with Enter, Space or ArrowUp/ArrowDown; in the menu the arrows, Home and End move, Enter picks and Esc closes it back to its button without clearing the selection. Esc anywhere else clears the selection, except in a text field or an open dialog.

A screen-reader-only polite status says "N selected" a moment after the count settles, so a quick run of ticks is read once, and "Selection cleared" when it goes. The notice after a change is a status (an alert when an undo fails). Icon-only buttons keep their label as the accessible name, and a disabled action reads its reason. The toolbar is aria-busy while an action runs.
The bar and its notice rise 10 px and fade in over 220 ms and leave in 160 ms; menus fade up 4 px. Only opacity and transform move. Under reduced motion they appear and go at once.

Every target is 44 px tall. The bar sits at the bottom of its scroll box (sticky) or of the screen (fixed, with a spacer of its height), above the safe area. Above maxInstant rows, or when some ticked rows are off screen, a change calls onNeedsConfirm instead of running, so nobody changes rows they cannot see with one click.
